pages.name: French Defense: Winawer Variation, Maróczy-Wallis Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Na5 with no knight in reach of a5; plan 1 called the a-file open (Black's a-pawn is on a7). Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Poisoned Pawn, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Kf1 with White's bishop on f1; plan 2 targeted a d4-pawn that has gone and called the g-file open (White's g-pawn stands). Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, Poisoned Pawn, Main Line, 13.Nxc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Kf1-g1 king walk with the bishop on f1; plan 2 had ...a5-a4 where the main line is ...a6. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 b6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an ambiguous ...Nc6-a5, ...Qb6 with Black's pawn on b6, and a c4-pawn that does not exist. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 b6 8.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed the bishop to b7, read as a move and blocked by d5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 b6 8.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 3 had the ...Ba6 manoeuvre and plan 1 had Qg4 and h4-h5, which read as moves while Black is in check. Rewrites of plans 1 and 3 were rejected (the f3-knight blocks Qg4, and after 8...Bd7 White usually keeps the bishop with 9.Bd3 or 9.Ba4), so the old text was kept with British spelling in overview and plans 3-4; plan 1 references added to the skips.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 Nbc6 8.a4 Qa5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a5 with Black's queen on a5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 Nbc6 8.a4 Qa5 9.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ba3 'exchanging Black's active bishop' (Black has no dark-squared bishop) and f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; plan 2 targeted a c4-pawn that does not exist; plan 4 called d4 an isolated target. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling in overview and plan 3.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 Nbc6 8.a4 Qa5+ 9.Bd2 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight and d4 used as a square with White's pawn on it; plan 2 said ...c4 opens the b-file. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: French: Winawer, 6...Ne7 7.Nf3 Nbc6 8.a4 Qa5+ 9.Bd2 Bd7 10.Bb5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ba3 for a bishop on d2 that cannot reach a3. A rewrite was rejected (the plan after 10.Bb5 is unconfirmed: ...a6 and Bxc6 are common), so the old text was kept with British spelling (overview, plans 1-2) and the Ba3 reference added to the skips.
